mechanism.claim: A large completed daily change in Cboe VXEEM/VIX isolates emerging-market uncertainty relative to broad US equity volatility. When BTC is already in a high realized-variation regime and its completed overnight return confirms the implied risk direction before the next US session, the cross-market move should persist for eight hours.
mechanism.side: negative sign of completed delta log(VXEEM/VIX), which must equal the nonzero BTC overnight-return sign

external_support.VXEEM: Cboe Emerging Markets ETF Volatility Index: expected 30-day EEM volatility
external_support.VIX: Cboe Volatility Index: expected 30-day S&P 500 volatility
external_support.untested_adaptation: relative emerging-market volatility plus BTC confirmation is tested as an eight-hour BTC relay

mechanism.why_distinct: No prior repository alpha uses VXEEM. RVSBR-12 used RVX small-cap volatility without BTC direction confirmation; EMVCR uses emerging-market uncertainty and requires a separate completed BTC overnight path.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized variation must have a causal rank of at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: external daily emerging-market volatility plus next-session 09:35 ET confirmation timing is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.relative_volatility: log(VXEEM_close/VIX_close) on exact common Cboe source dates
features.shock: current relative_volatility minus immediately previous exact common-source observation
features.shock_z: (shock-current strict-prior mean)/strict-prior sample std over at most 252 prior finite shocks; minimum 126; current excluded
features.btc_overnight: log return from source-date 16:00 America/New_York exact 1m open through next exact common-source date 09:30 America/New_York, using the completed 09:29 minute close
features.confirmation: sign(btc_overnight) equals negative sign(shock), both nonzero
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over 1,440 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars ending at, but excluding, next source date 09:30 America/New_York
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous exact source-date variations; minimum 126; current excluded; rank >= 0.65

clock.decision: after next exact common Cboe source date 09:30 America/New_York BTC paths are complete
clock.entry: same source date exact BTCUSDT 09:35 America/New_York 5m open
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official VXEEM/VIX economic definitions, an independent BTC confirmation path, and the user-required high-volatility regime

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, confirmation, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
